description:
The frame is 13.5” and is a suitable size for girls, teens or women 4’ – 5’2”. The frame is all steel which is very durable and will last forever if taken care of properly. Rusting on the frame will not be an issue because it is completely painted which acts as a protectant. The curve of the frame is a very classic cruiser design, the top bar arches down, making it easier to step over and get on the bike.

This Bella is a three speed cruiser bike, which has an internal gear system located inside the rear wheel. This gear system has only one cable that runs from the handlebars shifter to the rear wheel. The cable is neatly tucked under the frame to keep the bike looking clean. It is simple and easy to use and will require little to no maintenance at all. The shifter is located by the right handlebar grip and the rider simply twists the grip to change speeds, it is simple, easy, and effortless. Internal 3 speed bikes can function properly for many years without ever doing any maintenance at all. Riding up hills with the Bella Classic 3 Speed Bike won’t pose any problems as the different speeds will give you varying degrees of resistance to make the uphill climb easy.

13.5” Steel Frame with 24” Aluminum Wheels and Front/Rear Fenders

3 Speed Women’s’ Bike with Shimano Internal Gear System, shifts quickly and easily and requires little maintenance

Thick top tube design with Hawaiian flowers, Front/Rear Fenders, and Painted Rims

Three Speed Bike with a Pedal-Backwards Coaster Brake for easy pedaling and smooth braking

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Chrome Plated Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Black Grips

Bicycle Weighs 38lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women 5’ – 6’ Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 80% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
